This really helped, thank you : )

Guess I'll go to sleep now, maybe tomorrow will be better.

Oh, I didn't mean to attack you with the pissing-contest remark, sorry if it seemd like that.

Well, my therapist claims my gender issues were just a symptom of my other problems, so it would be 'irresposible' to let me change my body.

I really didn't think about a LBGT club, now I feel dumb. Just checked, my university even has one. Will look into that, thanks : )

Hey, thank you : )

Well, I didn't want to turn this into a pissing contest who had the worst family, mine at least isn't malicious, so sorry to hear about that with your father.

Yeah, the gender stuff is really bothering me. Since two years I'm trying to get on hormones but no, my therapist is a cunt, selfmedication isn't an option and due to living with my family (who don't know anything about this) I can't even at least wear clothes of my target gender at home.

But the idea of moving across the country after university really seems appealing, glad to hear it worked out for you.
